title: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in the Stock module import endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, to bypass authorization checks and perform unauthorized actions such as reading file contents and creating Serial No and Batch records.
